# PixelCraft - Privacy-First Browser Photo Editor Studio

> PixelCraft is a free, privacy-focused online photo editing studio that operates 100% client-side in the web browser. All rendering, image upscaling, photo compression, filtering, and format conversions happen locally on the user's device with zero server uploads.

## Core Capabilities

- **100% Private & Secure**: No images are uploaded to any external server. All processing runs via local browser Web APIs and JavaScript.
- **Smart Photo Compression**: Reduce image file sizes up to 90% with customizable WebP and JPEG compression levels.
- **Image Resizing & Upscaling**: Multi-pass interpolation, sharp detail enhancement, and crisp nearest-neighbor mode for pixel art.
- **Format Conversion**: Full support for JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, GIF, BMP, and SVG export.
- **Color Adjustments & Filters**: Real-time controls for brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, sepia, and detail sharpening.
- **Transformations**: 90-degree left/right rotations and horizontal/vertical flipping.
- **Watermark Text Overlay**: Custom text overlays with adjustable positioning, font sizes, color selection, and drop-shadows.

## Supported File Formats

- Input: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, GIF, BMP, SVG
- Output: JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, SVG

## Architecture & Tech Stack

- **Client-Side Rendering**: HTML5 Canvas API
- **HEIC Conversion**: `heic2any` library
- **TIFF Processing**: `UTIF.js` library
- **UI Framework**: Native HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ JavaScript

## Links

- [PixelCraft Studio Web App](https://pixelcraftart.vercel.app/): Main online photo editor workspace.
